persona.name: Thibault Nguyen

occupation.title: Head Barista and Shift Supervisor
occupation.organization: A specialty coffee shop in Vieux-Lille
occupation.description: Runs the bar, trains new hires, and manages morning rushes that start at 7h30. On his feet six hours straight most shifts, off at 16h on weekdays but works most Saturdays. His fiancee works a classic 9h-18h in logistics, so their evening schedules just barely overlap.

persona.education: BTS in hospitality management in Lille; barista championships taught him more than the diploma did, he says.
long_term_goals: Open a small coffee-and-brunch place with his fiancee
Get their wedding paid for without touching the shop fund
Cook more of his grandmother's Vietnamese dishes from memory
Take Linh to Vietnam for the first time since he was six
persona.style: Warm, chatty, service-industry polished — he remembers names, orders, and your dog's name. Talks about food with genuine hunger and rates everything out of ten unprompted. Full sleeve tattoo, canvas apron energy even off shift. Says yes to new things quickly and figures out the budget after, which Linh gently audits.

traits: Hardworking to a fault on his feet
Optimistic about plans, vague on details

interests: Trying every new restaurant opening in Lille
likes: Cooking with music on and Linh taste-testing
Anything with fish sauce and lime
His espresso machine at home, an engagement gift to himself
dislikes: Cooking for one when Linh works late
Supermarket queues after a standing shift

beliefs: Food made with attention tastes different, even simple food
Spending on eating well is not wasted money
Service work deserves more respect than it gets
You learn a person by cooking with them

general: Buys ingredients enthusiastically, forgets half a plan by Thursday
Cooks big weekend meals, survives on shop pastries weekdays
Follows a dozen food creators and actually tries their recipes
Splits everything 50/50 with Linh via an app

morning: 6h10 up on shift days, first espresso at the shop before opening
Rush from 7h30 to 10h, then a real breakfast at 11h
workday: Bar until 16h, inventory and orders on Tuesdays
Walks home through Vieux-Lille, buys something he didn't plan to
evening: Cooks when energy allows, football Mondays
Dinner with Linh at 20h30 when their schedules align
weekend: Sunday: big market run at Wazemmes, long cooking session, friends over

health.physical: Sturdy but his knees and lower back complain from standing shifts; drinks more caffeine than any guideline permits.
health.mental: High-energy and social; gets restless and a bit low on his rare solo evenings.

relationships.name: Linh Tran
relationships.description: A logistics coordinator who plans their finances and pretends to be stricter than she is; she wants weeknight dinners to stop being 'whatever's left at Carrefour City at 19h50.'

relationships.name: Ba noi (grandmother)
relationships.description: Lives with his parents in Roubaix; measures nothing, teaches by hand-slaps and taste, and is the reason he cooks at all.

relationships.name: Max
relationships.description: A sous-chef who mocks meal kits professionally but admits they'd suit Thibault's chaos.
